mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The mapping preserves competing explanations, discriminating evidence, differential support and contradiction, and iterative narrowing without premature commitment. Its limits retain hypothesis coverage, evidence dependence and test sensitivity as constraints on attribution.

target_fidelity.rationale: Narrowing plausible activation obstructions and retaining unresolved dependency interactions provides an explicitly bounded contribution to identifying necessary parts and barriers to simple feature ranking. The mapping expressly avoids claiming that it establishes every necessary feature.

operational_coherence.rationale: Usability observations and targeted prototype comparisons can support some dependency explanations while contradicting others, warranting revision of their plausibility. The inference remains at the level of candidate obstructions and uncertain interactions.

validity.rationale: The diagnostic mechanism transfers coherently and contributes to the retained target question within explicit attribution limits.

uncertainty: The packet supplies no comparison outcomes, so it does not identify which proposal parts are necessary or which interactions actually occur.
The completeness of the explanation set and the discriminatory strength of particular observations remain unknown; the mapping bounds its inference accordingly.
